brief.text: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Approval from the Reserve Bank of India for re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan asthe Whole-time Director (designated as Executive Director) of HDFC Bank Limited
brief.summary: HDFC Bank Limited has received approval from the Reserve Bank of India for the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, holding DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director. The approval was granted via RBI communication dated November 12, 2026. The re-appointment is for a period of one year, effective from November 23, 2026, at the extant remuneration. Mr. Rangan is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank. He is not debarred from holding the office of a director by any SEBI order or other authority. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

brief.line: V. Srinivasa Rangan re-appointed as Whole-time Director.

brief.text: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
brief.summary: HDFC Bank Limited has approved the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director for a period of one year effective from November 23, 2026. This approval follows recommendations from the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and consent from the Reserve Bank of India. The re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Rangan will continue at extant remuneration. He is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank and is not debarred from holding office. The bank will seek shareholder approval for this re-appointment.

brief.line: V. Srinivasa Rangan re-appointed as Whole-time Director.

routine.text: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
routine.summary: HDFC Bank Limited has intimated the schedule for an analyst and institutional investor meeting under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The meeting with Morgan Stanley is scheduled for the Twenty-Fifth Annual Asia Pacific Summit. The event will take place on November 18, 2026 to November 19, 2026. The mode of the meeting is in-person. The location is Singapore. The bank notes that the schedule may change due to attendee exigencies. Any revision will be communicated to the stock exchanges. This information is for dissemination purposes.

routine.text: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Redemption of Commercial Paper
routine.summary: Titan Company Limited has fully redeemed its Commercial Papers with a face value of 1000 crore rupees. The securities carry the ISIN code INE280A14617 and were originally issued on 14th August 2026. The company confirms that maturity proceeds have been paid to all holders on 12th November 2026. This intimation is issued in compliance with SEBI Operational Circular No. SEBI/HO/DDHS/P/CIR/2021/613 dated 10th August 2021. A copy of the notice is available on the company website at www.titancompany.in. The communication was signed by Dinesh Shetty, General Counsel and Company Secretary.

routine.text: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
routine.summary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.
